entities.name: Louis Kébreau
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis Nerval Kébreau is a Haitian Catholic retired prelate who served as Archbishop of Cap-Haïtien from 2008 to 2014. He was ordained as a priest in 1974, before being appointed Bishop of Hinche in 1998. He retired in 2014.
